# google_cloud_trace_trace_sink

Describes a sink used to export traces to a BigQuery dataset. The sink must be created within a project.

~> **Warning:** This resource is in beta, and should be used with the terraform-provider-google-beta provider.
See [Provider Versions](https://terraform.io/docs/providers/google/guides/provider_versions.html) for more details on beta resources.

To get more information about TraceSink, see:

* [API documentation](https://cloud.google.com/trace/docs/reference/v2/rest/v2beta1/projects.traceSinks)
* How-to Guides
    * [Trace data exports overview](https://cloud.google.com/trace/docs/trace-export-overview)

## Example Usage - Cloud Trace Sink Basic


```hcl
resource "google_cloud_trace_sink" "default" {
  provider = google-beta

  name           = "cloud-trace-trace-sink-test"
  output_config  = {
    destination = "bigquery.googleapis.com/projects/myProject/datasets/traces"
  }
}
```

## Argument Reference

The following arguments are supported:


* `output_config` -
  (Required)
  The export destination.
  Structure is [documented below](#nested_output_config).

* `name` -
  (Required)
  The name of the sink.


<a name="nested_output_config"></a>The `output_config` block supports:

* `destination` -
  (Required)
  The destination for writing trace data.
  Supported formats include: "bigquery.googleapis.com/projects/[PROJECT_ID]/datasets/[DATASET]"

- - -


* `project` - (Optional) The ID of the project in which the resource belongs.
    If it is not provided, the provider project is used.


## Attributes Reference

In addition to the arguments listed above, the following computed attributes are exported:

* `id` - an identifier for the resource with format `projects/{{project}}//traceSinks/{{name}}`

* `writer_identity` -
  A service account name for exporting the data. This field is set by sinks.create and sinks.update.
  The service account will need to be granted write access to the destination specified in the output configuration.
  To create tables and to write data, this account needs the dataEditor role.
  E.g.: "service-00000001@00000002.iam.gserviceaccount.com"


## Timeouts

This resource provides the following
[Timeouts](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/plugin/sdkv2/resources/retries-and-customizable-timeouts) configuration options:

- `create` - Default is 20 minutes.
- `update` - Default is 20 minutes.
- `delete` - Default is 20 minutes.

## Import


TraceSink can be imported using any of these accepted formats:

* `projects/{{project}}/traceSinks/{{name}}`
* `{{project}}/{{name}}`
* `{{name}}`


In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, use an [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) to import TraceSink using one of the formats above. For example:

```tf
import {
  id = "projects/{{project}}/traceSinks/{{name}}"
  to = google_cloud_trace_trace_sink.default
}
```

When using the [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import), TraceSink can be imported using one of the formats above. For example:

```
$ terraform import google_cloud_trace_trace_sink.default projects/{{project}}/traceSinks/{{name}}
$ terraform import google_cloud_trace_trace_sink.default {{project}}/{{name}}
$ terraform import google_cloud_trace_trace_sink.default {{name}}
```
